items.b: SOTHEBY'S SELLS A CARTIER CHEICH FOR HK$26.52M IN HONG KONG
items.t: The one-off white-gold prize watch carried a HK$8.0m to HK$40m estimate. Hodinkee converts the result to US$3,413,124 and SJX to US$3.38m.

items.b: ELMWOOD'S PUTS A £2M HIGH ESTIMATE ON AN 8.03-CARAT BLUE
items.t: The pear-shaped Fancy Light Blue carries a £1.5m low estimate for a London sale on 1 October. The house counts only two UK precedents above eight carats, in 1865 and 2008.

items.b: CHINA'S GOLD IMPORTS TOP 1,000 TONNES IN EIGHT MONTHS
items.t: January to August ran past the roughly 886 tonnes imported in all of 2025, at a cost near US$158.8bn. The PBOC added 20.2 tonnes in August.

items.b: DE BEERS CUTS SCOPE 1 AND 2 EMISSIONS 14% SINCE 2021
items.t: The 2025 Sustainability Report books US$70m committed to Botswana's Diamonds for Development Fund and 375,000 acres under conservation management.

items.b: NATURAL DIAMOND COUNCIL RENAMES ITSELF THE DIAMOND COLLECTIVE
items.t: The body dropped the qualifier from its name on 22 September. Its first fashion partnership is promised for 2027; RAPI's 1-carat index is down 5.1% on the year.
